profiles.evidenceBoundary: This profile defines the cases a future R049 receipt must execute. Structural or semantic acceptance does not authenticate NEST, process topology, status custody, buffer/configuration/wiring history, or sender-universe truth. The upstream execution gate remains NOT_RUN until a receipt binds the exact profile, source commit, toolchain, test bytes, and result.
